{{Recipe}}

'''Swiss meringue''' is a variety of [[Cookbook:Meringue|meringue]] made by heating egg whites and sugar over a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]] before [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipping]] to stiff peaks.

== Ingredients ==

* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (500 g) [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|superfine sugar]]

== Procedure ==

# Put the egg whites and sugar into a stainless steel bowl.
# Place the bowl over [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmering]] water and [[Cookbook:Whipping|whip]] with a wire [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] until the mixture is 120°F (50°C).
# Remove the bowl from the heat and continue [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipping]] until the meringue is completely cool.
# Use as desired or as directed in your recipe.
